aiNotes.heading: The AI runs on your iPhone.
aiNotes.body: ReelClip uses Apple Intelligence to help you find moments worth keeping. It runs entirely on your iPhone. Your video never leaves your device.
canDoItems: Read your transcript to understand what was said and find moments like hooks, quotes, or key topics
Check still frames across your video for objects, on-screen text, and faces, and note when each appears
Combine what it sees with what was said, so prompts like “remove the product shots” or “keep the talking-to-camera parts” work
Suggest clip ranges or passage removals you can review, adjust, and approve before anything is saved
cantDoItems: Watch full video in motion. It samples still frames at intervals and reads the transcript, but cannot follow action or pacing between frames
Understand audio emotionally (tone, sarcasm, music). It reads transcript text and audio levels
Take in a very long video all at once. Past a point it has to work in sections
aiNotes.limitsHeading: These limits come from the model, not the app
aiNotes.limitsBody: The list above describes what Apple's on-device model can handle today. When Apple improves it, ReelClip picks up the improvement.
aiNotes.footnote: Apple Intelligence requires iOS 26 and a supported device. It can be turned off at any time in Settings. When unavailable, ReelClip falls back to on-device audio and visual analysis without any AI features.

faqs.question: Is my video uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. ReelClip runs every analysis (cuts, AI plans, transcripts) entirely on-device. Your source video is copied into the app's private sandbox, processed locally, and the original file in Photos is never touched. See the Privacy Policy for the full data flow.

faqs.question: My import says 'file doesn't exist' even though the video is there.
faqs.answer: The video is probably still in iCloud Drive, with only a placeholder on your iPhone. Open it once in the Files app to pull down the full copy, then import again. ReelClip needs the real file on the device before it can read it.

faqs.question: How do I get ReelClip?
faqs.answer: ReelClip is available on the App Store. Search for ReelClip or visit the App Store link on this page. It requires iPhone running iOS 26 or later.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund on my subscription?
faqs.answer: Yes. Refunds are handled by Apple. Go to reportaproblem.apple.com, sign in with the Apple ID you used to subscribe, and request a refund for the ReelClip charge. We can't process refunds directly.

faqs.question: Why does the website use reelclips.app?
faqs.answer: ReelClip is the product name. We keep the existing reelclips.app domain so existing links and emails continue to work. The iOS bundle id and .reelclip project extension also remain unchanged for compatibility.

about.heading: Built for video that never leaves your phone.
about.intro: ReelClip is a strictly on-device iOS app for cutting long recordings into share-ready clips. Every cut plan, transcript, and AI pass runs on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is logged, nothing is shared with anyone.
whyParagraphs: Most AI video editors upload your footage to a cloud server, run it through a third-party model, and ship back a finished clip. That is the wrong default. Long recordings — interviews, podcasts, vlogs, screen captures — often contain material that is private, sensitive, or unreleased. The right answer is to do the work on the device that already has the video.
Apple Intelligence and the Foundation Models framework made that possible on iPhone in 2025. ReelClip is built on top of that.
doesItems: Four cut modes: Cut (split by duration), Transcript (cut the dead air), Slice (manual highlights), AI (describe what you want, let on-device Apple Intelligence pick the moments).
Translate captions into other languages and dub the audio with synthesized translated speech — all on-device.
Export SRT, VTT, and plain-text subtitles. Burn captions into the final clip with four caption styles.
Save the finished clips straight to your Photos library.
doesNotItems: We do not upload your video, audio, transcripts, or AI feature packs to any server.
We do not use third-party AI providers, cloud LLMs, or bring-your-own-API-key integrations.
We do not embed third-party analytics, ad SDKs, or cross-app trackers.
We do not place watermarks on paid-plan exports.
about.whoBody: ReelClip is built and operated by an independent iOS developer.

rules.description: Always write ReelClip as one word, with a capital R and C.
Give the logo room to breathe. Keep nearby copy, edges, and graphics at least one mark-width away.
Use the lime logo on off-black or dark footage. Use the app icon when space is tight.
Do not recolour, outline, stretch, crop, or add effects to the logos.
